# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent = **seed** (both cand_0001 and cand_0002 were REJECTED and reverted). I rebuilt the
proven-safe subset of their edits and added a fully code-bounded card fix, deliberately
DROPPING every edit a prior RESULT showed regressed a passing task.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | basic-economy over-refusal | 17, 22 | agent reads "basic economy cannot be modified" and refuses cabin+passenger+baggage changes that keep the same flights; tries cancel-and-rebook | KNOWLEDGE (internal policy contradiction) + BEHAVIORAL | narrow "Change flights" prose + in-body segment guard |
| 2 | cabin-change mispricing / wrong decision | 12, 11 | agent forgets to ×num_passengers (12: thinks $600 fits $650 budget, really $1192 → wrongly upgrades) and treats a downgrade as full-fare refund/cancel (11) | BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP (no exact-price tool) | new read compute tool + cabin-pricing prompt |
| 3 | wrong payment card | 37 | user says "card ending 7334"; agent never fetched user, guessed credit_card_4959530 (5018) instead of credit_card_9074831 (7334) | CAPABILITY-GAP (no card-by-last-four path) | new optional `card_last_four` param + in-body resolution |
| 4 | multi-booking mess | 23 | 3 bookings + payment-field-name confusion (`id`/`type` vs `payment_id`) + wrong flight dates | BEHAVIORAL | SKIPPED — cannot verify a fix; book_reservation edits regressed task 8 before |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body guard | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | raise actionable error ONLY when `reservation.cabin=='basic_economy'` AND requested (flight_number,date) set ≠ current set (pure cabin change passes) | BOUNDED — no passing task calls this tool (8,25 book; 19 cancels; 40 update_passengers) |
| 1 | decision-rule narrowing | policy.md "Change flights" | segment change on basic economy = forbidden (→cancel); cabin/passenger/baggage keeping same flights = allowed. Leads with the segment prohibition to preserve task 19's cancel path | additive/narrowing; no bundled 3-step example (F3's example is my hypothesis for the cand_0002 task-40 break) |
| 2 | new compute tool | tools.py `get_reservation_flights_update_price` (READ) | returns amount_due = per-pax diff × num_passengers from live prices; +ve pay / −ve refund-difference | BOUNDED — read-only, no passing task calls it |
| 2 | missing-rule + worked example | policy.md "Change cabin" | ×num_passengers, call the preview tool + state exact figure, all-or-nothing, downgrade refunds only the difference & don't cancel-as-substitute | this exact block shipped in BOTH prior runs and never appeared in any `broke={}` |
| 3 | new optional param + resolution | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` `card_last_four` | if user names a card by last four, tool resolves it to the matching payment_id (raises with the on-file last-fours if none match) | BOUNDED — optional (default None → old behavior); no passing task calls this tool |

## Verify-the-fix (ran each tool body on the exact trace inputs against the live DB)
- T12 `get_reservation_flights_update_price('YAX4DR','business',same-flights)` → `amount_due=1192` (≫ $650 budget) → agent should decline the upgrade, add only 2 bags = gold. PASS.
- T11 preview('GV1N64','basic_economy',same-flights) → `amount_due=-5244` → downgrade refunds the $5244 difference (not full fare, not cancel) = gold. PASS.
- T17/22 guard: `update_reservation_flights('FQ8APE','economy',SAME flights,gift_card)` → cabin becomes economy, NO raise (guard does not fire on a pure cabin change). PASS.
- Guard fires: `update_reservation_flights('FQ8APE','basic_economy',[different flight])` → raises the segment-change error. PASS.
- T37 `update_reservation_flights('M20IZO','business',same-flights,payment_id='<junk>',card_last_four='7334')` → resolves to `credit_card_9074831` (last_four 7334) = gold payment_id. PASS.
- Blast radius: confirmed from traces that passing tasks 8,19,25,40 call NONE of {update_reservation_flights, get_reservation_flights_update_price} → all three code edits are zero-blast-radius by construction.
- Schema build: both tools' openai_schema builds; `card_last_four` present and NOT in `required`.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single-agent) diagnosis: extracted gold action_checks + actual tool-call args for all 10 tasks from the trajectory JSON, then ran candidate tool bodies against the live tau2 DB (venv at .cache/capevolve-ci/venv) to verify each fix and its non-firing on passing inputs.
- Read ./prior_iterations/cand_0001 + cand_0002 (PROCESS + diff) and LEDGER/JOURNAL RESULT lines. Learned: (a) pricing tool + cabin prompt fixed {11,12} in BOTH runs → re-shipped verbatim; (b) anti-cancel prose broke 19 → I lead with the segment prohibition and scope anti-cancel to same-flight cabin changes only; (c) book_reservation payment-docstring rewrite broke 8 → book_reservation UNTOUCHED; (d) F5 card-selection PROSE co-occurred with the {25,40} break → I moved card selection entirely into a bounded code param with NO policy prose; (e) F3's bundled 3-step basic-economy example is my best hypothesis for the task-40 break → I avoid any bundled example.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The three code edits are zero-blast-radius (no passing task uses those tools). Keep code, not prose, for card selection and the segment boundary.
- The "Change cabin" pricing/downgrade block is proven safe across two runs — keep it.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 23 (multi-booking): cannot construct a VERIFIED single edit that flips the final DB (3 bookings, payment-field confusion, wrong return dates); any book_reservation code change risks passing 8/25 (cand_0001 proved book_reservation edits regress 8). Deferred until a delegating book path can be verified DB-identical on 8/25.
- Global permission/refusal prose: not loosened anywhere; the segment boundary is enforced in code and the prompt only NARROWS.
